heading: Desks calendar
pageDescription: See live desk availability, tentative holds, and confirmed bookings. Select a free day to create a booking, or open a booking span to edit it.

status.bookedTooltip: Tentative hold — counts as expected revenue under Upcoming payments until you confirm it.
status.assignedTooltip: Paid booking — counts toward your revenue.

actions.extraEarningsTooltip: Earnings outside desk and room bookings — coffee sales, events, one-off rentals.
actions.freeUpDeskTooltip: Open up one or more desks for specific days so someone else can book them — e.g. when a member says they won't use their desk that day. It doesn't change the member's plan or revenue.

ai.noComparable: No comparable {{period}} to compare to yet.
ai.adviceQuiet: Pretty quiet period. Time to do some marketing?
ai.adviceLow: Not bad — maybe ping your network or follow up with leads?
ai.adviceMedium: Decent. A nudge to your waiting list could fill the empty seats.
ai.adviceHealthy: Healthy occupancy. Keep the momentum going.
ai.adviceGreat: Great occupancy. Coworking magic in full effect.

spans.closedTitle: Space closed — click to book it anyway
spans.dayOffTitle: Regular day off — click to book it anyway
spans.bookingClosedNotice: The space is closed on this date — this booking was made before the closure.
spans.publicTitle: Booked through your public booking page

popover.contractEndsPrompt: Want to extend it before it lapses?
popover.cancelPrompt: Cancel this booking? All {{scope}} will be removed and any flex days are returned.

floorPlan.emptyDesc: Go to Floor Plan Editor to arrange your desks

customIncome.title: Add extra earnings
customIncome.placeholder: e.g. Coffee sales, Event fee, Day office rental…
customIncome.addedToastDesc: The entry is available in Overview.
customIncome.errorToastDesc: Could not add the extra earnings.

freeUp.title: Free Up Desk
freeUp.description: Opens up the selected desks for the chosen days so someone else can book them — e.g. when a member says they won't use their desk. This only frees those days; it doesn't change the member's plan or revenue.

modal.ongoingContractTooltip: A rolling / month-to-month contract with no fixed end date. Auto-books the next monthly cycle; mark each as paid to extend by another month. Leave it unticked for a fixed-term booking.
modal.deskConflict: {{desk}} isn't free for the whole range.
modal.noDesksFree: No desks are free for this range. Pick a shorter range or a different start date.
modal.name: Name *
modal.priceNote: Enter the total price for this booking
modal.customDatesAndPrice: Custom — set your own dates & price
modal.sellingFlex: Selling {{label}}: {{visits}} visits · {{price}}/visit. Activates when you book.
modal.shareTooltip: Share booking confirmation via Telegram, WhatsApp, or Viber
modal.quickSaveTip: Tip: Press Ctrl+Enter to save quickly
modal.groupEditDesc: This booking runs {{start}} → {{end}}. Saving reassigns every day in that range from {{from}} to {{to}}, not just the day you clicked. To change a single day, cancel and book that day on its own.
modal.freezeDesc: Days from this date onward will be banked and the desk released. Earlier days stay active and counted as revenue.
modal.endContractDesc: Ongoing bookings renew until manually ended. Choose the final day for this contract — days after will be removed.

toasts.noAvailabilityDesc: No available desks found in the next 30 days
toasts.noAvailableDeskDesc: Could not find an available desk
